name: TOB Website Settings
description: Settings for the public truthofbible.org website, read by truth_of_bible.api.website. Contact form messages are saved as TOB Website Enquiry and emailed to the recipients below. The web Bible reads the database at Bible Database Path.

fields.label: Contact Form Recipients
fields.description: Email addresses that receive every contact form message, one per line or comma separated. Replying to the email replies to the sender.

fields.label: Confirmation Subject
fields.default: We received your message — Truth of Bible

fields.label: Confirmation Message
fields.default:
Dear {{ full_name }},

Thank you for reaching out to Truth of Bible Ministries. Our team has received your message and will pray with you and reply soon.

“I will not forget you.” — Isaiah 49:15

Truth of Bible Ministries

fields.label: Bible Database Path
fields.description: The read-only database built by truth_of_bible/bible_web/build.py. Relative paths are inside this site's folder.

fields.label: About
fields.options: Which versions appear on the website is set in truth_of_bible/bible_web/catalogue.json (web: true/false, with each licence). Rebuild the database after changing it.

fields.label: Articles
fields.description: TOB Article → Publish commits content/articles/<slug>.json and the cover image to this repository; the push rebuilds the site.

fields.label: GitHub Token
fields.description: Fine-grained token for this repository only, with Contents: Read and write.

fields.label: Review Emails
fields.description: Emailed a review link for each new article the autopilot writes. One per line or comma separated.

fields.label: Community Discussion Webhook
fields.description: Optional: n8n /webhook/tob-community-discussion — opens a discussion for each newly published article.

fields.label: Website Popup
fields.description: A popup on every page of truthofbible.org with today's blessing verse (from TOB Blessing Verse, shown in the reader's own Bible), the website's features and the app. Turn it off here and it stops within a minute.

fields.label: Popup Title
fields.description: Shown above the verse. Leave empty for the default.

fields.label: Show the App Section
fields.description: App features and the Google Play button (the link carries utm_source=website, utm_medium=popup).

fields.label: Show After (Seconds on a Page)
fields.description: Never immediately: Google ranks pages lower on phones when a popup covers them right after a visitor arrives.

fields.label: Show Again After (Days)
fields.description: How often one visitor sees it. 1 = at most once a day.

fields.label: App: Verse of the Day popup
Show the Verse of the Day popup
fields.description: Once a day, on the first app open after 5 am. Admins only = System Managers see it, to try it before members do.
